div.p: A pointer to the ID of another element.
Used to create internal links within an XML instance. Optionally available in all elements except the root element.

div.egXML: <occupations> <occupation> <term>Assistant examiner - level III</term> <placeName target="#place1">Bern</placeName> </occupation> </occupations> <places> <place id="place1"> <label>Bern</label> <role>Place of work</role> <address> <addressLine addressLineType="street">Stauffacherstrasse 65/59g</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="postalCode">3003</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="municipality">Bern</addressLine> </address> </place> </places>
